segments.name: Transmission, Power & Gulf
segments.description: Provides FERC-regulated interstate natural gas transmission and storage, market-based storage, offshore gathering, and LNG-related investments for utilities, municipalities, and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Williams' interstate natural gas pipelines, which are presented in the Transmission, Power & Gulf segment as described under the heading "Business Segments," are subject to regulation by the FERC

segments.name: Northeast G&P
segments.description: Provides natural gas gathering and processing services for producers in the northeastern United States.
segments.evidence: Williams' gathering, treating, and processing operations are presented within the Transmission, Power & Gulf; Northeast G&P; and West reporting segments, as described under the heading "Business Segments."

segments.name: West
segments.description: Provides natural gas gathering and processing services for producers in western supply areas.
segments.evidence: Williams' gathering, treating, and processing operations are presented within the Transmission, Power & Gulf; Northeast G&P; and West reporting segments, as described under the heading "Business Segments."

segments.name: Gas & NGL Marketing Services
segments.description: Markets natural gas and NGLs, providing asset management, trading, storage, and transportation for utilities, power generators, producers, and petrochemical users.
segments.evidence: Williams' natural gas and NGL marketing services are presented primarily within its Gas & NGL Marketing Services segment.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Includes upstream operations and minor business activities that are not reportable segments, as well as corporate operations.
segments.evidence: Other includes upstream operations and minor business activities that are not reportable segments, as well as corporate operations.

revenueModel.text: Williams is paid fees based on volumes of natural gas gathered, treated, and processed, regulated reservation and commodity charges for interstate transportation and storage, and sales of marketed natural gas, NGLs, and equity NGL production.
revenueModel.evidence: Williams is generally paid a fee based on the volume of natural gas gathered and/or treated, generally measured in the Btu heating value.
